description: 5 exemplars (one German) + 3 near-misses + 2 counterexamples. Authored 2026-10-14 under road-to-sentences-the-tree-can-back, whose step made this skill's Node floor defer to the project's own .nvmrc / engines.node rather than to a dated baseline, and so brought it into check_routing_coverage's touched-skill scope. Exemplars cover five of the eight entry points the skill's own 'When to use' lists: first-time environment setup, an ANDROID_HOME / command-not-found path error, a CocoaPods install failure on Apple Silicon, a Metro or Watchman cache loop, and a New Architecture migration. Near-misses share the mobile and React vocabulary and belong elsewhere: Detox / Maestro device-test selection is the cross-link the skill itself names (mobile-e2e-strategy), a web React component is react-shadcn-ui, and pinning one toolchain for the whole team in a container is devcontainer. Counterexamples guard two homonyms in this skill's own trigger set: 'native' as a database's own operator, and 'expo' as a trade show.

queries.q: fresh laptop, I need to get an Expo app building on both the iOS simulator and an Android emulator
the android build dies with SDK location not found and ANDROID_HOME is empty — where do I set it?
pod install keeps failing with an FFI error on my M3 — ruby version mismatch?
Metro reloads in a loop and fast refresh never picks up my edits — how do I clear the caches properly?
wir wollen auf die New Architecture migrieren — Fabric und Turbo Modules, was muss ich am Podfile und an gradle.properties umstellen?
which device-test runner should we pick for the app — Detox, Appium or Maestro?
queries.note: runner selection, the cross-link this skill names → mobile-e2e-strategy

queries.q: build the settings form as a React component with shadcn for our web dashboard
queries.note: says React, means the web surface → react-shadcn-ui

queries.q: pin the whole toolchain in a container so every new hire gets the same node and java
queries.note: environment reproducibility via a container image → devcontainer

queries.q: rewrite this to use a native Postgres jsonb operator instead of going through the ORM
queries.note: says native, means a database's own operator

queries.q: we're exhibiting at an expo next month — design the booth banner and the handout
queries.note: says expo, means a trade show
